notes.base: New base: arm A is upstream dev 736a0682d38f0a1c6592f34b1c6749fea221da42 ('Merge pull request #2255 from JustVugg/perf/cuda-f32-gemm'), after PR #0 (#2212-#2217) merged; the final4 manifests (../final4) used dev 62eaa9dc249b67567b9cbc83e43fbc875a8b94c1. The pr1 tip 34fe3f808d348f28e0813b02f42eeea14c2414d3 (refresh/pr1-reap-prefill, tree 517adae7cb35c09eb59ee2588989d659a589bfa2) is 8 commits on top of this base (meta/tips.txt: dev_is_ancestor_of_pr1=yes). dev still refuses the batched GPU MoE for the 132-expert model: every A serve.log has 'v4_gpu moe-batch=off (unsupported model geometry)', every B/C serve.log 'v4_gpu moe-batch=on bank=132-experts', and only C 'v4_gpu moe-double=on'.
notes.prewarm: Expert-cache prewarm: the base includes upstream #2111 (463f8443, 'a serve fills the expert cache before its first request (#2109)'), so both dev and the pr1 tip prewarm at serve start. At --ram 40 the plan holds 59 of 132 experts per layer, so the prewarm picks experts from .coli_usage, which was empty (size 0, same mtime) before and after every sample (sample.txt usage_before/usage_after; summary.json usage_history_changed []). Every A/B/C serve.log says '[v4] expert cache: 59 of 132 experts per layer fit and no usage history says which, so it fills as experts are used': the prewarm read nothing, and the expert cache started empty in every sample as on 2026-10-15.
notes.warmup: warmup_runs 0: request 1 (long_prefill) is the first request the client sends to each freshly started server process; no warm-up request precedes it in that process. (The run's discarded W sample was a separate server process before A s1; see notes.cache_state.)
notes.cache_state: The OS page cache was not dropped between samples.
